model.description: Recursive N-level node builder for the shared rb-trace-tree (src/public/ts/trace/rb-trace-tree.ts:317). FIX (architect design): (a) recursive node type at EVERY depth; per-node chevron = hasChildren===true || (children?.length ?? 0) > 0, so WINDOW nodes get their own expand/collapse; (b) kill the eager recursion (the :339 self-call that explodes the whole subtree) — build ONLY the node + its chevron, STORE inline children on the element, defer child-build to onToggleChildren OPEN which builds ONE layer (each child collapsed with its own chevron). Correct initial collapsed state; window label != active-command placebo. Backward-compatible (children already optional) so /trace's 2-level trees still render. Design-ahead — expert points its impl here (marker on the buildSeedNode decl); NOT self-minted (#126). R31.3 render chain.
